notes.zh: 这是魂灵之月窠的立约提案；三个选项互斥：立约 / 拒绝（永不再提）/ 自寻出路（天选之国不可选）。
notes.en: Covenant offer of the Cradle of Souls; the three options are exclusive: covenant / refuse (never offered again) / forge our own path (not for a chosen empire).

notes.zh: 立约360天后发生；若已背叛该赞助者或已与轮回之终末立约则不会出现。
notes.en: 360 days after the covenant; does not fire after betraying this patron or after a covenant with the End of the Cycle.

scope.zh: 魂灵之月窠立约提案、立约、一年后确认/弃约、天选者与“自寻出路”分支均已核对。共享的 utopia.2681/2682 与塑造虚境项目在五个契约故事中各自出现。
scope.en: The Cradle of Souls offer, covenant, confirmation/renunciation a year later, the Chosen and "forge our own path" branches were checked. The shared utopia.2681/2682 and the Shaping the Shroud project appear in each of the five covenant stories.

uncertain: covenant_event is launched by the engine from the patron definition (patron_types.txt comment: patron covenant offer); the exact UI/attunement threshold is not in script.
